mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see AEO results for a general contractor's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving AEO is an ongoing process, not a quick fix. While some minor website optimizations might show initial shifts within a few weeks, significant improvements in search rankings and organic traffic typically take several months, ranging from 6 to 12 months, or even longer. This timeframe allows search engines to recrawl, re-evaluate your site's content, and recognize consistent demonstrations of authority and trustworthiness over time. Patience and consistent effort are key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Significant AEO results for a general contractor's website typically take 6 to 12 months, as search engines need time to re-evaluate consistent demonstrations of authority.
